modelDescription: The Fusion Bull Prime is a shotgun that is truly in a class of its own. It is perfect for both hunting and shooting at the range, and it is packed with high-end features that will make any demanding shooter happy. With its gauge of 12 and capacity of 4+1, it is versatile and powerful, capable of handling a variety of ammunition types and loads. The two barrels that come with this shotgun are a 20-inch slug barrel equipped with slug sights and a 28-inch vent rib barrel equipped with a brass bead front sight, with a high polished blued finish and an HD-chrome lined chamber for added durability. The front fiber optic sight and bead allow for improved accuracy, and the receiver top dovetail is perfect for attaching a rail or other accessories. In addition to the 20-Inch Slug barrel equipped with slug sights that include white dot rear and fiber optic front, the Fusion Bull Prime also comes with an extra 28-inch vent rib barrel assembly, giving you the option to switch between different barrel lengths depending on your needs. The choke tube set allows you to customize the shot pattern to your specific needs, and the LOP (length of pull) measures 13.9 inches, providing a comfortable fit for most shooters. The walnut stock is finished with a satin poly and checkering for a secure grip, and the entire shotgun weighs in at 7.2 pounds, making it well-balanced and easy to handle. The Fusion Bull Prime is equipped with a beavertail forearm for added stability when shooting, and the unique butt stock has raised cheek pieces on both the right and left sides, making it suitable for both right and left-handed shooters. The stock is finished with enhanced checkering for a secure grip, and the chrome bolt adds an extra level of durability. The dovetailed receiver is finished with beautiful engraving, adding a touch of style to this already impressive shotgun. When it comes time to transport and store your Fusion Bull Prime, you can rest easy knowing that it is protected by a padded hard case. And with its semi-automatic action, you'll be able to make rapid follow-up shots if needed. Whether you're out hunting or spending the day at the range, the Fusion Bull Prime is the perfect companion.
